currentCard.prompt: Работа какого органа создаёт пульсовую волну, которую можно почувствовать на запястье?

answers.note: Кровь к желудку поступает по левой и правой желудочным артериям.
Печень вырабатывает желчь, которая помогает эмульгировать жиры в тонкой кишке.
Повышенная активность щитовидной железы может сопровождаться учащённым сердцебиением.
В покое частота сердечных сокращений взрослого обычно составляет 60–100 ударов в минуту.

currentCard.explanation: При каждом ударе сердца в артериях возникает волна давления. Там, где артерии проходят близко к коже, эту волну можно почувствовать как пульс.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: Dealing with abnormal heart rhythms

literal.prompt: Работа какого органа создаёт пульсовую волну, которую можно почувствовать на запястье?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: BHF L137–148 explicitly links wrist arterial pulse to heart pumping and beat-generated pressure wave: heart alone directly creates the asked pulse. Stomach receives arterial blood(20.5L146,164,168), liver produces bile(23.6L31,52), thyroid may indirectly speed heart(BHFL212–216); receiving blood or altering rate is not direct generation. All choices are real organs with consistent genitive forms.

sourcesLocators.claimGround: Heart pumping produces pulse felt at wrist artery; every heartbeat creates pressure wave along arteries, palpable near skin.

sourcesLocators.locator: OpenStax20.5 complete returned paragraphL146 and tableL160–169
sourcesLocators.claimGround: Left gastric artery and right gastric artery supply stomach; no claim that these are its only vessels.
Liver produces bile exported to duodenum; bile emulsifies large lipid globules in small intestine, facilitating digestive enzyme action.
Sinus tachycardia may reflect overactive thyroid; many other causes also possible. Modulates rate, not a competing direct pump source.
Heart pumping chambers eject blood on contraction; supporting heart-pump context only, not independent direct pulse definition.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: При каждом ударе сердца в артериях возникает волна давления. Там, где артерии проходят близко к коже, эту волну можно почувствовать как пульс.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: BHF L145–148 explicitly states each heartbeat creates pressure wave along arteries and it is felt where arteries lie near skin. Both Russian sentences reproduce those two mechanism steps, name correct organ through “ударе сердца”, and avoid equating pressure-wave speed with bulk blood motion.

sourcesLocators.claimGround: Heart pumping produces pulse felt at wrist artery; every heartbeat creates pressure wave along arteries, palpable near skin.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Кровь к желудку поступает по левой и правой желудочным артериям.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 20.5 completeL146 names left and right gastric arteries supplying stomach; tableL164,168 repeats. Positive useful own-stomach vascular fact. It does not claim exclusive supply or adopt old SOURCE25 portal-vein/HOLD conclusions.

sourcesLocators.claimGround: Left gastric artery and right gastric artery supply stomach; no claim that these are its only vessels.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Печень вырабатывает желчь, которая помогает эмульгировать жиры в тонкой кишке.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 23.6L31 says liver produces bile;L52–54 states bile emulsifies lipid globules in small intestine. “Помогает эмульгировать” is accurate and does not call bile a digestive enzyme. Useful own-liver function, independently checked despite overlap with another card.

sourcesLocators.claimGround: Liver produces bile exported to duodenum; bile emulsifies large lipid globules in small intestine, facilitating digestive enzyme action.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Повышенная активность щитовидной железы может сопровождаться учащённым сердцебиением.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: BHF L212–216 lists overactive thyroid as possible underlying cause of sinus tachycardia. “Может сопровождаться” correctly preserves possibility, not universal diagnosis; it is a useful thyroid/cardiac-effect fact without claiming thyroid itself pumps the pulse wave.

sourcesLocators.claimGround: Sinus tachycardia may reflect overactive thyroid; many other causes also possible. Modulates rate, not a competing direct pump source.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В покое частота сердечных сокращений взрослого обычно составляет 60–100 ударов в минуту.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: BHF L163–164 gives60–100 beats/min at rest;L135–142 connects measured pulse and heart rate, andL190–193 recognizes lower rates in active people. Adult “обычно” is a typical general-adult educational range, not a universal diagnostic limit, exercise target or child-specific rule. Adds a concrete quantity and condition beyond pulse source asked in prompt/key.

sourcesLocators.claimGround: Typical resting heart rate60–100; normal variation and physically active people with slower rates prevent absolute lower-limit interpretation.

absoluteLevel.ground: Heart causes pulse felt at wrist is broad adult everyday/school knowledge. Four real organs give comparable labels; thyroid is a meaningful indirect-rate distractor. No specialist pressure-wave mathematics, rhythm diagnosis or anatomy of vessels is needed to solve.
